negative_findings.description: cbcg.me serves the same page under several locale prefixes (/me/, /en/, /r/, /c/, /reg/, /eng/). Two fetches using the /r/ prefix (the /r/ payment-services-and-e-money page and /r/statistika/statisticki-podaci/platni-promet) returned HTTP 404, while the /me/ and /en/ equivalents rendered fine.
negative_findings.result_summary: 404 on /r/ variants; content retrieved successfully from /me/ and /en/ paths. Treated as a routing quirk, not a dead source.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector keyed to search-engine-supplied /r/ or /c/ URLs will silently fail; canonicalise every CBCG URL to /me/ (sr) and /en/ before scheduling.

negative_findings.description: No open data API, SDMX endpoint or CSV service was found for the CBCG card/ATM/POS statistics. The quarterly series is distributed only as per-table ZIP archives (Excel inside) under /slike_i_fajlovi/fajlovi/fajlovi_platni_promet/usluge_e-novac/{year}/.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only ZIP/Excel and PDF distribution observed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection must be a file-harvest plus spreadsheet parser, with a schema-drift check each quarter; filename conventions embed the quarter and are the only reliable versioning signal.

negative_findings.description: No source was found publishing a contactless-vs-e-commerce split of Montenegrin card transactions as a standalone series. The CBCG breakdown found is by terminal type ('po vrsti terminala', i.e. ATM vs POS vs other) and by domestic/cross-border, not by acceptance mode. A World Bank assessment separately notes that active card counts are not published.
negative_findings.result_summary: Terminal-type and geography splits exist; contactless / remote (CNP) split not located; active-card counts not published.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The contactless and e-commerce share requested in this cell may have to be inferred from card-scheme or bank statements rather than official statistics — a material caveat for any adoption claim.

negative_findings.description: Local-language searching surfaced no Montenegrin equivalent of a national card-scheme/processor statistics publication (no local ATM-sharing network bulletin comparable to BH mreža in Bosnia was confirmed for Montenegro).
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in sr returned only CBCG, UBCG and bank pages; no domestic scheme/processor statistics publisher identified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Switch/processor-level volume data, if it exists, is likely private and would need commercial or interview-based access.

coverage_gaps.description: Contactless share and e-commerce (card-not-present) share of Montenegrin card transactions are not covered by any source located in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe Visa/Mastercard CEE market releases, Montenegrin bank annual reports and UBCG 'Bankar' articles for stated contactless/e-commerce percentages; also check whether the 2026 amendments to the reporting Decision (Sl. list 10/26, 47/26) introduced new remote-payment reporting fields.

coverage_gaps.description: Card processors, ATM/POS vendors and independent ATM deployers operating in Montenegro were not identified in this pass; the cell covers regulator and issuer sources only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snowball from bank tender notices, the public procurement portal (CRNA GORA javne nabavke) and vendor press releases to map who supplies and services the ATM/POS estate.

coverage_gaps.description: Only the current-quarter (Q1 2026) file URLs were observed; the archive depth of the card/terminal ZIP series (the page's year archive reportedly reaches back toward 2006) was not enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the year sub-directories under /slike_i_fajlovi/fajlovi/fajlovi_platni_promet/usluge_e-novac/ and the page's year selector to build a full backfill manifest before the first production run.

coverage_gaps.description: Field definitions behind the card/terminal tables (active vs issued cards, ATM vs POS vs 'other device', double-counting of multi-scheme cards) are not documented in the statistics pages themselves.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Read the reporting-form annexes of the Odluka o izvještajima and record a definitions dictionary alongside the harvested tables; flag the 2026 amendments as a likely series break.

coverage_gaps.description: All local searching was done in Montenegrin/Serbian Latin script; Cyrillic-script variants and Albanian-language sources (relevant to northern/eastern Montenegro media) were not searched.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Repeat key queries in Cyrillic (платне картице, банкомати) and in Albanian (kartat e pagesave, bankomatë) to check for additional coverage.

brief: For Montenegrin card, ATM and POS statistics the landscape is strongly centralised: the Central Bank of Montenegro's quarterly 'Podaci o platnim uslugama i elektronskom novcu' series is effectively the only primary producer, publishing cards issued, card-acceptance devices, and card transactions split by terminal type as per-table ZIP/Excel files compiled from mandatory bank reporting under the Odluka o izvještajima o platnom prometu (Sl. list CG 82/17 with 2026 amendments). Around it sit CBCG's monthly Bilten, annual reports and RTGS/DNS/IPS payment-system statistics, plus per-bank tariffs, registers and financial statements that allow a bank-level view the aggregates omit. International redistribution via the IMF Financial Access Survey (mirrored by the World Bank and FRED) supplies comparable ATM/POS density benchmarks, while World Bank FSAP/CGPSS assessments usefully document the series' own gaps. The main blind spot for this cell is the contactless and e-commerce split, which no located official source publishes; that, plus the absence of any machine-readable API and unenumerated archive depth, are the priorities for the next pass.
